items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I didn't know he was gone either.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know who else. Somebody told me. I, I don't know. I didn't even see him. Somebody.
I just found out last week that he was gone because I've got his sister-in-law, Mrs. Ziegler, and Mercy, who, between life and death, a heart attack.
Uh, I didn't know he was gone either.
